# Acquired goal revision enters a pending task

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every partial law with counted work, a pending task finishes in exactly its remaining work plus one tick, every shorter run leaves it pending, and, pending and delivered being exclusive, no shorter run delivers it. Under the existing versioned-delivery invariant, rewriting the head packet's remaining encoding preserves its captured route, progress and other work, so the revised head is again such a task for the new request, with the same remaining work and the same number of ticks. For every condition and every valid installation with a pending head, acquired revision reaches the pending task exactly where it is warranted: acquisition, revision, reform, the rewrite and its delivery run exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, the condition under which the comparison warrants learning over attendance; the endpoint then enacts the new practice, retains the one historical loss, adds none and uses actual work support, ending with three records and the work, reserve and used units (2, 6, 10). The earlier composition is its instance at the harmful conditions; the protocol itself supplies the two outcome laws, the goal encoding and the work units.

Canonical source: [CommonTaskRevision.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/meta-attractor/CommonTaskRevision.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Binary reversible translation, a valid queue and protected synchronous head rewrite; no unmodeled irreversible effects before endpoint enactment. Consecutive ticks provide completion.
- Reuse acquired two-practice evidence, changed purpose and selector reform; G0/J, correspondence, authority and responsiveness are explicit. The branch consumes one rewrite work unit; route-maintenance cost is not modeled.

Learning, instruction and effect are differentiated relations in one activity, not opposing players. The goal encoding covers only the two declared practices, with actual relevant conditions required to match.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.30.0-rc2 actually rebuilt the repository import closure and audited declarations; inherited claims and the new composition remain distinct. Metadata checks do not replace proofs. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Relabeling or writing an unencoded value can fail; the old task can be faithfully executed and add loss. Changed conditions after acquisition can also make the revised practice harm maintenance. No open joint-purpose formation or correction through unrestricted change.
